cases.scenario: A refused step changes nothing, and a confirmed write survives a hard stop of the server
cases.given: Minutes waiting for approval; a second instance of the app
cases.when: Approve the minutes from a stale copy, then from the current one; create a meeting through the second instance, then kill that server process and read the database
cases.then: The refused approval leaves the minutes WaitingApproval with no minutes.issued entry and the next approval issues them; the created meeting is there after the kill
cases.aiNote: Measured: approving from a stale copy answered 409 MSG401; the minutes stayed WaitingApproval, not issued, with 0 minutes.issued rows; approving from the current copy then issued them (200); a meeting created through the second instance (201) was there as Draft after its process was killed. Re-run on a clean local database: the earlier refusal (409 MSG434) came from a unique index left by migrations that are not in the repository. · Evidence: QA run SYS-NFR 20261123-071217-0c98bde8 · Run by the QA runner on a local build of app 6baba24f.

cases.scenario: Change emails (reschedule, cancel, role change) are queued and delivered or marked failed
cases.given: Published meetings whose invitation emails were sent; the invitation dispatch queue and the email outbox
cases.when: Reschedule, cancel and hand over the chair (WF-07); read the queue and the outbox
cases.then: Each change email reaches the outbox and is delivered or retried up to 8 times; the meeting state never reverts
cases.aiNote: Measured on a clean local database after WF-07: 9 Rescheduled, 9 Cancelled, 4 RoleChanged and 60 Invitation dispatches, all Materialized, none Pending or Failed; the reschedule and cancel emails are in the outbox, at most 1 attempt per email (the local build marks @trustcabinet.local Failed without sending); no rescheduled meeting was sent back for approval. The earlier Fail came from a unique index (meeting_id, to_address) left on the old local database by migrations that are not in the repository. · Evidence: QA run SYS-NFR 20261123-070943-0c98bde8 · Run by the QA runner on a local build of app 6baba24f.

cases.scenario: A failed transcription keeps the audio and can be retried without uploading again
cases.given: An uploaded recording while the speech worker is down
cases.then: The recording stays available; the transcript is marked failed with a reason; "Chạy lại" queues the same recording again with no new upload
cases.aiNote: Measured: recording Available; transcript Failed "Không kết nối được máy chủ nhận dạng giọng nói." shown as "Chưa chuyển được thành chữ: …" with "Chạy lại"; retry re-queued it (Pending, "Đã đưa bản ghi vào hàng chờ chuyển thành chữ.") and it failed again with the same reason, as the worker was still down. · Evidence: QA run SYS-NFR 20261122-185048 · Re-run on a clean local database: same result, QA run SYS-NFR 20261123-070126-0c98bde8 · Run by the QA runner on a local build of app 6baba24f.
